MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue) WHERE a<>b AND type(l)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND l.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(pa), (b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(pb) WHERE pa<>pb
RETURN count(l) AS n, count(DISTINCT a)+count(DISTINCT b) AS m

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[r*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE all(x IN r WHERE x.linkId IS NOT NULL AND startNode(x).issueKey IS NOT NULL)
AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p))
AND all(i IN range(0,size(r)-1) WHERE EXISTS { (nodes(p)[i])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x), (nodes(p)[i+1])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE x<>y })
AND NOT EXISTS { (a)-[l]-(c:Issue) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x),(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE x<>y} }
AND NOT EXISTS { (b)-[l]-(c:Issue) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x),(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE x<>y} }
RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [x IN r|x.linkId] AS links LIMIT 5

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[r*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE all(x IN r WHERE x.linkId IS NOT NULL)
WITH p,r,a,b,[n IN nodes(p)| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)|q.personKey])] AS as
WHERE none(x IN as WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(as)-2) WHERE as[i]<>as[i+1])
AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p))
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND y.personKey<>as[0] }
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND y.personKey<>as[size(as)-1] }
RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [x IN r|x.linkId] AS links, size(r) AS len

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[r*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE all(x IN r WHERE x.linkId IS NOT NULL)
WITH p,r,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns,[n IN nodes(p)| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)|q.personKey])] AS as
WHERE none(x IN as WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(as)-2) WHERE as[i]<>as[i+1])
AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[0] }
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[size(as)-1] }
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [x IN r|x.linkId] AS links, size(r) AS len

MATCH p=(a:Issue) ((x:Issue)-[l]-(y:Issue) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND x<>y AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u),(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5} (b:Issue)
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns,relationships(p) AS r
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
WITH p,a,b,ns,r,[n IN ns| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)|q.personKey])] AS as
WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[0] }
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[size(as)-1] }
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [x IN r|x.linkId] AS links, [n IN ns|head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q)|q.projectKey])] AS projs, as, size(r) AS len

MATCH p=(a:Issue) ((x:Issue)-[l]-(y:Issue) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND x<>y AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u),(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5} (b:Issue)
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns,relationships(p) AS r
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..])
WITH p,a,b,ns,r,[n IN ns| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)|q.personKey])] AS as
WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[0] }
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[l]-(c:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE l.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[size(as)-1] }
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [i IN range(0,size(r)-1)|[ns[i].issueKey,ns[i+1].issueKey]] AS hops, [x IN r|[x.linkId]] AS links
